name: Arabian Mills for Food Products Company
summary: Arabian Mills for Food Products Company produces and sells wheat and feed products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It offers flour, livestock and poultry feed, and bran. The company was formerly known as Second Milling Company and changed its name to Arabian Mills for Food Products Company in November 2023. Arabian Mills for Food Products Company was founded in 1977 and is based in Riyadh, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
